name: BSN medical GmbH
reason: BSN medical was acquired by Essity in April 2017 and operates as an integrated brand/subsidiary under Essity's Medical Solutions segment. Because the operating subsidiary still active under its own name/brand in this market, it is mapped as active, but the parent entity represents the primary consolidated commercial controller.

name: Systagenix Wound Management, Limited
reason: Systagenix was originally acquired by KCI (Acelity) in 2013, and subsequently its corporate parent Acelity was fully acquired and absorbed by 3M in 2019. Its historical manufacturing facility in Gargrave was sold to Scapa Healthcare in 2018 under a long-term supply agreement.

name: LM Farma Indústria e Comércio Ltda.
reason: LM Farma is the specialized manufacturing business behind the Curatec advanced wound care brand in Brazil, but it has been acquired and absorbed into the international URGO Group (operating via URGO Brasil).
